summary: Revenue fell 100.0% to $0 in 2025. The operating loss widened to $89.8M from $67.3M.

risks: We have a limited operating history and have no products approved for commercial sale…
We are substantially dependent on the success of our lead product candidate, AlloNK, which is in clinical development
Current clinical data regarding the efficacy of NK cell therapies against autoimmune diseases are limited…
Clinical trials are expensive, time-consuming, difficult to design and implement, and have an uncertain outcome
strategy: Advance our lead product candidate, AlloNK, through clinical development in RA…
Demonstrate the clinical potential of NK cell therapies to address limitations of auto-CAR-Ts
Scalability: AlloNK is an allogeneic, off-the-shelf product candidate that can be manufactured at scale, cryopreserved…
